verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's own docs say users can launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click and build a template that packages their environment so any GPU can run it. A template sets up the rented machine with whatever software is needed, and docs refer to configuring 'any docker image' through an image config editor with docker create/run options. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pulling a user's own image from a public or private registry (including registry authentication), detail on the template build workflow, and independent or hands-on confirmation that custom images work as described.
